However, when the number of nodes is less than six,
the processing time will be carried out (recipe time * number of missing nodes * 1.75).
The matrix will take the largest element of each of the six nodes and calculate the average.
The closer the quantities between the six primitive elements are, the higher the multiplication factor will be.
The actual acceleration magnification is (0.4+0.45exp(-0.05Variance)+
0.15(ln(1+exp(-Variance))/ln2)) * (Mean / 500).
Variance is the variance of the largest element in the six nodes,
Mean is the average.
When the type of the six elements is not the six original elements,
Each missing one adds a fixed 1 second to the time.
Gain up to 1145.14% acceleration multiplier.

When the number of nodes is 4, calculate the nodes with the highest rates of air, fire, entropy, and order.
Use the essence quantity of the node with the highest rate of each essence for subsequent calculations.
min=min(fire,air,entropy,order,10);max=max(fire,air,entropy,order,10);
Basic speed bonus equals 1/11.4514 + (0.7-1/11.4514)*(1-exp(min-10)).
If there is too much disparity in the quantity of the above essence, there will be a penalty mechanism.
Punishment speed bonus equals (0.7-baseSpeedBonus)*(max-min)/max
Final speed bonus equals the sum of the two.

parallel = The sum of diffusion cell values (Novice = 1, Adept = 2, Master = 4, Grandmaster = 8)

name: Skypiercer Tower
info: Wir müssen wissen. Wir werden wissen.
Thaumaturgical research confirms: Essentia degradation occurs spontaneously. while recombination demands human intervention to overcome inherent resistance.
Synthesizes compound aspects. Requires at least 1A EV. Processing time depends on aspect tier: primal aspects are tier 0; a compound aspect's tier is the max tier of its components plus 1.
A tier 1 aspect takes 2 seconds. Each additional tier multiplies the time by 3/2, rounded down.

Essentia Mode: Supply essentia via Infusion Provider. Automatically matches two combinable aspects from the network, outputs through Essentia Output Hatch. Each ring adds 16 parallels and enables perfect overclocking.
Passive Mode: Select aspects manually for continuous synthesis. Each ring adds 6 parallels and divides time by 1.2^rings (≈1/10 time at 13 rings).
Crystal Essence Mode: Input crystals via Input Bus, output through Output Bus. Bonuses same as Passive Mode.
Note: Non‑passive modes require blocking to ensure only one type of aspect is synthesized at a time; otherwise it may interfere or even jam (also does not support color input).

info: To work properly the center of the meteor has to be 48 blocks above the highest block of the multi.
